title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on Galatians and Ephesians, translated by William Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Galatians, chapter 3. In his Commentary on Galatians and Ephesians, in the William Pringle translation, Calvin writes at Galatians 3, verse 1: O foolish Galatians. An expostulation is here interwoven — I should rather say, inserted — amidst his doctrinal statements. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 3, chapter 11.
